summary: First test run for ProjectForum MVP. 24/24 backend tests pass via pytest. Frontend critical flows (login, signup data-testids, dashboard tabs, add-project, admin login + status update, public profile no-auth, browse challenges, reset-password) all work via Playwright.

minor.issue: Inconsistent admin auth: /admin/login validates via body password, but all other /admin/* require X-Admin-Password header. Confusing dual mechanism. Works but should be documented.
Direct password reset by email-only is intentionally insecure per PRD (no email verification). Acceptable for MVP but should be flagged.
deadline_preference parsing uses ''.join + int fallback; if user enters '0 days' it defaults to 30 silently.

issues: Uses browser-default input type='month' for Date Completed - browser-native picker rather than a styled component. Acceptable for MVP, but inconsistent with rest of UI.
profile-progress only renders on My Profile tab (not Overview). Per test brief 'profile completion % renders' - acceptable but consider showing on Overview too.

action_items: (Optional) Add an 'Overview' card showing profile completion % so /dashboard Overview tab also surfaces it.
(Optional) Use a styled month-picker for Add Project modal instead of browser default.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 530-line file; manageable now but consider splitting routes (auth, challenges, admin, profile) into routers if features grow.
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded fallback; .env has a value so production OK. Good.
All MongoDB reads exclude _id via {'_id': 0}. Good.
All endpoints use async/await and Motor properly. Good.
CORS allow_origins from env, currently '*' with allow_credentials=True; in browsers this combination is rejected. Consider explicit origins for production.
Reset password endpoint has no rate limiting and no email verification - acceptable for MVP per PRD, but security risk in production.
Admin password sent as plain header X-Admin-Password and also stored in localStorage on the frontend - acceptable for an internal admin tool but should be flagged.

Frontend uses pf_token in localStorage and pf_admin_password key sent as X-Admin-Password header. Project modal uses native HTML type='month' input - tests must use 'YYYY-MM' format for proj-date. profile-progress testid only on My Profile tab.
rca of the issue: No bugs found - MVP working end-to-end.
